title: Extraneous Calibrations when opening android app
symptom: Several times over the past week, extraneous calibration points have been added. It seems that sometimes when I open the app, it grabs my last blood test glucose value (even four hours prior) and then uses that as a new calibration value. I have to do a new finger prick and 'over ride calibration' to not end up with a ludicrous calibration.
